Name: Vanilla Greenhouse by trasjoper (PIF)
Author: trasjoper
Description:
[center][/center][center][/center][center][/center][center][size=4]🌿 [b]Personal Greenhouse[/b] 🌿[/size]
[/center]
[i]A Stardew Valley Mod[/i]
This is a custom greenhouse originally designed for the mod [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20537]PIF - Personal Rooms[/url][/b], which allows players to create and access personalized spaces without altering the game’s original structures.

🛠️ [b]Main Features:
[/b]✔️ Plenty of space to grow [b]all vanilla crops[/b] from Stardew Valley.
🍂 Season-themed layout, with areas dedicated to the respective season of each crop.
🏡 Compatible with the original greenhouse: [b]does not replace it[/b], and is accessed through [b]PIF - Personal Rooms[/b].
🎨 Made for players like me who love seeing their crops [b]perfectly organized[/b] in an aesthetic and functional environment—without sacrificing space or breaking the game's visual harmony.

[line]I wanted a space where I could watch my crops grow in a clean, organized, and seasonal setting while keeping the charm of each season alive. This greenhouse is the result of that idea. I hope you enjoy it as much as I do! 🌾✨
[line]
[center][size=4]🏗️ [/size][b][size=4]Vanilla Greenhouse Replacement[/size][/b][/center][b]
[/b]If you’d rather have this greenhouse [b]replace the game’s original vanilla greenhouse[/b], you now have that option!
Just download the file:
[b]📁 (CP) Vanilla Greenhouse[/b]
With this version:
[list]
[*][b]PIF - Personal Rooms is no longer required[/b]
[*]Your farmhouse greenhouse will use this new design from the start
[*]You still enjoy the same organized, seasonal layout—now in the base game location
[/list][line]

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko [/url]– As always, for the beautiful flowers and the autumn recolor.
[url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/r1kai]r1kai [/url]– For their season sheet.
